title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Watson (rib) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Watson is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Watson left last Thursday's game early before eventually returning later in the game. He is on track to be good to go this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The Packers designated RB Chris Brooks to return to practice.
items.impact: Brooks was back on the field during practice on Wednesday. He has been on injured reserve for the past few weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer Wednesday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was working on the side with a trainer during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is another absence from practice for Skattebo. His status for Week 9 is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harold Landry III (knee) working hard to return
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Harold Landry is working hard to return.
items.impact: Landry has been on the PUP list since the start of September. He remains uncertain to return anytime soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Greg Van Roten will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Greg Van Roten will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Roten's status remains up in the air for Week 9 against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (illness) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Barmore is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Barmore will be sidelined from practice to begin the week due to an illness.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henderson did not play last week. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) will not practice Wednesday
items.desc: A.J. Brown is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brown was hopeful to practice this week. He will need to be monitored on Thursday and Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Bailey (ankle) to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said David Bailey will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bailey will be limited in practice to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quincy Williams (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Quincy Williams is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams will be sidelined with a hamstring injury. His status for Week 9 against the Saints is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Maliek Collins (elbow) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Maliek Collins is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Collins will be sidelined with an elbow injury. His status for Week 9 against the Saints is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaire Franklin (leg) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Zaire Franklin will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: LaFleur said Franklin is "making a lot of progress." His status remains unclear the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daron Payne likely out for season
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Daron Payne will likely be out for the season.
items.impact: Payne was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremy McNichols likely out for season
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jeremy McNichols will likely be out for the season.
items.impact: McNichols was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kadyn Proctor (concussion) to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kadyn Proctor will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Proctor remains in concussion protocol. His status remains uncertain heading into this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (knee) undergoes surgery
items.desc: Javon Kinlaw underwent surgery on Tuesday.
items.impact: Kinlaw got injured on October 19. He underwent additional testing that led to undergoing surgery this week. He will be sidelined indefinitely.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) expected to play Thursday
items.desc: Ezra Cleveland is expected to play on Thursday against the Ravens.
items.impact: Cleveland is dealing with knee and ankle injuries. He should be good to go on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) could be game-time decision Thursday
items.desc: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Bhayshul Tuten could be a game-time decision for Thursday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Tuten will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Thursday. Chris Rodriguez would be next up if he is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka was not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Egbuka cleared concussion protocol last week, but he was still ruled out for a foot/ankle injury. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jer'Zhan Newton (pec) trending in right direction
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said "the arrow is going up" for Jer'Zhan Newton.
items.impact: Newton remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) to return to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Micah Parsons will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: LaFleur said Parsons will be limited in practice on Wednesday. He will have his 21-day window opened.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear how much Delane will do in practice to begin the week. He did not play in last Sunday's loss against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Peter Woods (stinger) will not practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Peter Woods will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Woods is working his way back from a neck stinger.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Butker to remain Chiefs kicker in Week 9
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Harrison Butker will remain the team's kicker in Week 9 against the Jets.
items.impact: Butker will remain the team's kicker despite his recent struggles after missing three field goals in the past two weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kingsley Suamataia has 'good chance' to play in Week 9
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said "there's a good chance" Kingsley Suamataia is back at left guard this week.
items.impact: Suamataia was previously benched by Reid.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shedeur Sanders could start in Week 9
items.desc: Shedeur Sanders could start in Week 9 against the Saints.
items.impact: Deshaun Watson was placed in concussion protocol and it appears he'll unlikely he'll be able to clear it in time for this weekend. Sanders would be in line to start on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Wilson placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Jets placed WR Garrett Wilson in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Wilson sustained a head injury in Week 8 against the Raiders. His status for this week is all of a sudden up in the air. If he is ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. could both step into bigger roles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) trending in right direction
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Breece Hall is "trending in the right direction."
items.impact: Hall continues to trend in the right direction to return in Week 9 against the Chiefs. What his exact role will be remains uncertain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Campbell (neck) has full movement in lower body
items.desc: Lions LB Jack Campbell said he has "full movement" in his lower body.
items.impact: "I'm continuing to make progress with movement in my upper body," he said. "I know there's still work ahead, but I remain very optimistic. I'm taking things one day at a time, staying positive, and focusing on getting better." It is a great sign for Campbell following his scary injury on Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will practice on Wednesday, his first practice session with the team since injuring his hamstring in August.
items.impact: This is big news for the Saints offense and affected pass catchers. Devaughn Vele has been a viable option with Tyson out, but will see a target decrease as Tyson gets acclimated and playing time ramps up. Juwan Johnson could also see his target share suffer, but he has already been in a bit of decline. Still, Tyson should be usable for fantasy if not this week, certainly by the next.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) was listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Robinson has missed the last two weeks due to a hamstring injury, but this is a positive development for the Falcons' No. 2 RB. Robinson has been solid behind dual-threat star Bijan Robinson this season. Brian Robinson has averaged 4.0 yards per carry for more than 200 yards and four touchdowns in six games.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) set to return in Week 9
items.desc: Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) was listed as a full participant on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Bowman has missed each of the Falcons' last two games, but it looks like he will be back on the field in Week 9 against the Bengals. The second-year safety will likely cut into Sydney Brown's snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Divine Deablo (forearm) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Divine Deablo (forearm) was listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: The Falcons are playing in Spain this week and may have Deablo back in the mix on defense after sitting out the last two games with a forearm injury. Deablo registered 30 total tackles and a fumble recovery over the first six games of the campaign.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol
items.desc: Deshaun Watson has been placed in the concussion protocol.
items.impact: Watson took a big hit early in Sunday's loss to the Steelers, but he returned to the game just a few plays later after being cleared by medical. The Cleveland QB experienced some lingering symptoms earlier this week, however, leading the team to place him in the protocol. Watson does reportedly have at least a chance of returning for Sunday's game in New Orleans, but time will ultimately tell. Sheduer Sanders would take over at QB if Watson cannot go.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) returning to practice
items.desc: Mack Hollins (calf) will return to the practice field on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hollins has been out since Week 4 due to a calf injury, but the veteran receiver is ready to get back on the practice field for the Patriots. Hollins caught 15 passes for over 200 yards across the first four games of the season and will be a significant part of the offense once he returns to in-game action. That could potentially happen this week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk files for reinstatement with the NFL
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk has filed for reinstatement and is prepared to rejoin the 49ers on Friday.
items.impact: The Aiyuk saga continues around San Francisco. The veteran wide receiver has been on the left squad list since the summer, but the 49ers will now have to make a decision to keep, cut, or, if possible, trade him. Aiyuk has not played in an NFL game since 2024.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyler Huntley (toe) out for the season with turf-toe injury
items.desc: Tyler Huntley (toe) is set to get surgery to mend his turf toe injury and is out for the season.
items.impact: It's a big blow to the Ravens, who liked that Huntley could run a similar offense to Lamar Jackson, who is also out for an indefinite period. Joey Fagnano will start for the Ravens on Thursday, but the Ravens will likely make some sort of move to bring in a capable veteran to keep their season afloat.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rob Beal Jr. signs with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers signed former draft pick DE Robert Beal Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Beal played two games in Miami and logged one tackle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Owen Pappoe signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions are signing linebacker Owen Pappoe to their practice squad.
items.impact: The deal is pending a physical. Pappoe played for Arizona through last season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eric Murray placed on IR
items.desc: The Jaguars placed Eric Murray on injured reserve.
items.impact: Murray will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DaVon Hamilton placed on IR
items.desc: The Jaguars placed DaVon Hamilton on injured reserve.
items.impact: Hamilton went down with a torn quad for Jacksonville.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bishop Fitzgerald waived by Lions
items.desc: The Lions waived Bishop Fitzgerald.
items.impact: Fitzgerald will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Lampkin signs with Rams' active roster
items.desc: The Rams signed Cam Lampkin to their active roster.
items.impact: Lampkin will add depth on the 53-man roster for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre Brown released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released Tre Brown from injured reserve.
items.impact: Brown will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alex Bachman released by Rams
items.desc: The Rams released Alex Bachman.
items.impact: Bachman will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Freeland signed by Jets
items.desc: The Jets signed Blake Freeland.
items.impact: Freeland was signed by the Jets off the Bengals practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Yasir Abdullah placed on IR
items.desc: The Falcons placed Yasir Abdullah on injured reserve.
items.impact: Abdullah will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dean Connors (hand) placed on IR
items.desc: The Rams placed Dean Connors on injured reserve.
items.impact: Connors broke his hand. He is set to undergo surgery.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Max Mitchell placed on IR
items.desc: The Jets placed Max Mitchell on injured reserve.
items.impact: Mitchell will miss at least the next four weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Jackson signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed Drake Jackson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jackson will add depth for Atlanta.
